title: Senator Reid: they're shutting down our nukes

tellings.quote: immediately without a pause he goes the fact that they're shutting down our nukes basically

plain: Around 2019 or 2020, Harry Reid, the former Democratic leader of the Senate, answered a question about UFOs "immediately without a pause" by pointing to "the fact that they're shutting down our nukes." James Fox, a UFO investigator who says he put the question to Reid himself, tells Michels the story. If true, it means a senior senator believed UFOs had disabled American nuclear weapons.
